description: This Java class 'PatientIdentifierTypeEditor' extends a generic property editor 'OpenmrsPropertyEditor' for 'PatientIdentifierType' objects. It provides mechanisms to serialize and deserialize 'PatientIdentifierType' instances by ID or UUID, facilitating data passing through web forms or other mediums within the OpenMRS system.

classes.name: PatientIdentifierTypeEditor
classes.description: A property editor class for handling conversion between String/ID/UUID and 'PatientIdentifierType' objects within OpenMRS.

methods.name: getObjectById
methods.description: Retrieves a 'PatientIdentifierType' object by its integer ID via the OpenMRS patient service.

methods.name: getObjectByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a 'PatientIdentifierType' object by its UUID via the OpenMRS patient service.
